acceptanceCriteria: A shared test helper builds a valid PoolEntry
At least the PSR-V0-013 test uses it
body: Friction from the pool-checkpoint lane (2026-10-21, branch claude/batch-pool-checkpoint, V1-1701 and V1-0895). Observed: constructing a PoolEntry in tests needs about six non-obvious valid fields (queue ID, allocatedSeq, policy digest, attempt ID shape) with no helper. Expected: one helper that returns a valid entry with overrides.
title: Test fixture helper for valid Tasks PoolEntry values
